passive.name: Assassin's Mark
passive.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

spells.name: Five Point Strike
spells.description: Akali slings kunai in an arc, dealing magic damage and Slowing enemies at the tip by % for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Twilight Shroud
spells.description: Akali drops a smoke bomb, unleashing a spreading cover of smoke lasting seconds and granting herself % Move Speed decaying over seconds. Akali increases her max Energy by while the shroud is active. While inside the smoke, Akali is Invisible.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Shuriken Flip
spells.description: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation E1Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Perfect Execution
spells.description: Akali vaults over an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to all enemies in her path. Akali can Recast after seconds to execute a piercing thrust, dashing and dealing to magic damage based on missing Health.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Cast1Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
